<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count the peaks that fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (approximately 110–160 ppm). This will give the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
